integrity: The six scientific text/JSON files and two standalone verification artifacts are complete and self-contained, with decoded byte lengths and SHA-256 digests embedded in the private record. Direct finite experiments are corroboration and do not replace the field-uniform proof.
scientific_limitations: Results concern the reduced geometric support of the unital endomorphism equation scheme and exact finite-field rational-point counts. They do not assert scheme reducedness, intersection multiplicities, conjugacy classes, or monoid composition laws. Absolute historical priority is not established.
title: Endomorphism varieties of truncated two-branch Artinian nodes
